title: Round 3 manual Beamer frame, title, overlay and package-box review
method: Ten new downloaded-source frames were read manually, with native SVG/rsvg rasters and isolated authored-engine PDF/pdftoppm rasters. Original stock-Beamer reductions isolate five mechanisms. No renderer edits or builds. Exact comparison of the tracked fixtures is delegated to the combined followup gallery.
limitations: Purposive sampling finds mechanisms; it does not estimate corpus-wide popularity or fidelity.

Every reference is an isolated selected frame with its source preamble. Earlier body-local settings, section/toc/navigation state, bibliography processing and deck-wide counters may differ. These full-source rasters are semantic/manual evidence, not exact glyph scores.
Two dl4nlp isolated builds provide an empty flags.tex as directed by the author preamble; the native source is unchanged.

Three Naereen2019 Makefiles select XeLaTeX. Initial pdfLaTeX renders were superseded. Actual-engine font failures were resolved using explicit paths to identical installed TeX Gyre Pagella faces and omitting unused Fira Code family/monofont declarations. These are adapted references, not unmodified author builds.
Native corpus fonts/themes include diagnosed Metropolis/Fira Sans substitution and unknown trigon/serif/professionalfonts components. The stock reductions avoid these confounders.
Native flow-05 throws on both states; its native page count is unknown. Counts do not substitute overlayStepCount for emitted pages.
Introduction frame23 was jointly reviewed with the tables agent and must count only once in the combined distinct-frame total.

The five groups are fidelity targets with exact page-count/text witnesses, not allowances for existing failures. Positive controls here mean successful rendering and visually correct feature behavior; strict geometry results remain pending.

findings.mechanism: Built-in shrink=20 selects a minimum 20% frame-box reduction, cramped list spacing and top placement. Native short-list body geometry is identical to the unsized control.
findings.expected: Apply the Beamer shrink factor and cramped list glue, scaling the complete frame body and choosing a further reduction when needed to fit.
findings.witness: Stock reduction: both native body bounds are x28.452756,y98.814167,width307.289764,height65.49075pt; TeX shrink raster scales the list and places it near the frame top.

findings.mechanism: The scanner stores the frame subtitle, but the renderer omits the subtitle row for ordinary frames. Both command and frame-header argument forms reproduce the gap.
findings.expected: Paint the ordinary frame subtitle with its stock font/color/spacing and include its height in the title/body geometry.
findings.primarySource: beamerbaselocalstructure.sty frametitle/framesubtitle definitions; beamerouterthemedefault.sty frametitle template.
findings.witness: Stock TeX shows Connections and annual growth under Grid connections; native shows only the title and uses the same body geometry as the no-subtitle control.

findings.mechanism: Body overlays determine two native pages, but overlay-bearing title text is passed to ordinary text lowering and paints the command literally instead of projecting its visibility.
findings.expected: Evaluate stock only/uncover overlay commands inside ordinary frame titles for each page, preserving their respective space reservation semantics.
findings.primarySource: beamerbaseoverlay.sty only/uncover definitions and beamerbaseframe.sty frame-title preparation.
findings.witness: Native stock title text remains Outline \uncover<2>and reference or Research \only<2>at the institute on both pages. TeX reveals the suffix only on page2.

findings.mechanism: Stock invisible accepts omitted overlay syntax and hides its content. Native prints the command literally; inside a Beamer list the TeX label is hidden with the invisible item.
findings.expected: Project implicit invisible content with correct retained geometry and list-label visibility, without painting source. Preserve the passing stock block environment overlay behavior.
findings.primarySource: beamerbaseoverlay.sty590-592 declares invisible with default overlay syntax, selecting reallyinvisible/fakeinvisible.
findings.witness: The stock reduction compiles to two pages and has no native exception. TeX hides Introduction and label1 on both; native prints \invisible{Introduction} and label1.

findings.mechanism: A standard tcolorbox with colback/colframe/title and an ordinary itemize body is recognized as unsupported flow. No custom command, package skin or library is needed.
findings.expected: Support the basic package environment, box dimensions/padding, title and body colors/border, and ordinary supported body content. Start with this bounded package scope before advanced skins.
findings.primarySource: tcolorbox.sty basic environment/options and tcbdrawing.code.tex drawing backend.
findings.witness: Native emits one bounded unsupported card, whereas TeX paints the title, both list items and a blue framed/pale-filled box. The ordinary Beamer block control preserves the same supported text.

deferred.reason: This is a standard algpseudocode environment, not an author hack. Track as unsupported-environment recognition/package implementation work separately from the five current geometry/visibility groups.
Keep the source and error evidence. A stock invisible-list reduction does not reproduce the crash, so no crash fixture claim is made.
Independent stock small+display and small+align controls pass. Math command lowering, not the font environment alone, explains the observed literals; delegated to the math/text review.
Expanded tightlist/list declarations paint literally. Text agent owns the generic pre-item declaration reduction.
No actual overlayarea or squeeze-option occurrence was found in this corpus search; no invented source provenance.
